description: Returns Zenith's booking page for a Zenith Workspaces room, optionally with the date and duration filled in, plus a price estimate when a duration is given. Use when someone wants to book a Zenith room. Booking, account creation and card payment happen on Zenith's booking page, not in this tool; this tool does not check availability (use check_availability) or reserve anything. Includes the room's real photos (image_url, images).

space.description: Space name or id (Everest, K2, Denali, Summit, Atlas, Matterhorn, Evergreen Conference Room)

name: get_booking_link
title: Get booking link
